example.title: Cannery Row conveyor crossover lettered with the company name
example.place: Cannery Row, Monterey, Monterey County, CA

brief: A second enclosed crossover over the street: a white-painted enclosed timber bridge with a row of small windows and the company name in large black letters along its side, spanning between two-storey cannery buildings with flags. Two photos. Older than 1970: cannery crossovers are pre-war. Piles carried 10 m or more below the modelled bed (spec rule 4).
